scripts.dev: pnpm run build:schema && (pnpm -F babybox-panel-configer dev & pnpm -F babybox-panel dev & pnpm -F babybox-panel-backend dev)
scripts.stop: pm2 delete configer && pm2 delete babybox
scripts.start:main: cd "../dist" && pnpm install && pm2 start ../dist/index.js -n babybox
scripts.build: pnpm install && pnpm run build:schema && pnpm -F babybox-panel build && pnpm -F babybox-panel-backend build && pnpm -F babybox-panel-configer build
scripts.test: pnpm run build:schema && pnpm -F @babybox/config-schema exec vitest run && pnpm -F babybox-panel-backend exec jest && pnpm -F babybox-panel exec vitest run --environment jsdom && pnpm -F babybox-panel-configer exec vitest run && pnpm -F startup test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:schema && pnpm -F babybox-panel exec vue-tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json --composite false && pnpm -F babybox-panel-backend exec tsc --noEmit --pretty false
